subtitle_zh: 今天是我们乘坐 Discovery Princess 从加拿大温哥华出发后的第五天，
subtitle_en: Today is day five on Discovery Princess from Vancouver,

subtitle_zh: 我们来到了阿拉斯加的 Skagway。
subtitle_en: and we have arrived in Skagway, Alaska.

subtitle_zh: 这已经是我们的第四次阿拉斯加邮轮之旅，却只是第二次来到 Skagway。
subtitle_en: This is our fourth Alaska cruise, but only our second visit to Skagway.

subtitle_zh: Skagway 是一座不大的小城，却有着非常丰富的历史。
subtitle_en: Skagway is a small town, but it has a very rich history.

subtitle_zh: 十九世纪末克朗代克淘金热期间，
subtitle_en: During the Klondike Gold Rush in the late 19th century,

subtitle_zh: 这里曾经是成千上万淘金者前往加拿大育空地区的重要门户。
subtitle_en: this was a gateway for prospectors heading to Canada's Yukon.

subtitle_zh: 如今，老街、历史建筑和著名的 White Pass 铁路，
subtitle_en: Today, its streets, buildings, and White Pass railway

subtitle_zh: 仍然保留着一百多年前淘金时代的印记。
subtitle_en: still preserve traces of the Gold Rush era.

subtitle_zh: 今天上午我们先到小城走走，下午再乘坐 White Pass 景观火车。
subtitle_en: This morning we walk through town, then ride the White Pass train.

subtitle_zh: 另外三艘邮轮也陆续抵达了 Skagway。
subtitle_en: Three other cruise ships also arrived in Skagway.

subtitle_zh: 我们的 Discovery Princess 今天没有直接靠岸，
subtitle_en: Our Discovery Princess did not dock directly today,

subtitle_zh: 需要乘接驳船上岸。
subtitle_en: so we need to take a tender ashore.

subtitle_zh: 这与几年前港口发生的山体滑坡以及码头安全限制有关。
subtitle_en: This is related to a past port landslide and dock safety restrictions.

subtitle_zh: 我们登上接驳船，准备上岸了。
subtitle_en: We board the tender and get ready to go ashore.

subtitle_zh: 从这里还可以看到当年山体滑坡留下的痕迹。
subtitle_en: From here, we can still see traces left by the landslide.

subtitle_zh: 几分钟后，我们来到邮轮游客的集合区域。
subtitle_en: A few minutes later, we reach the cruise passenger gathering area.

subtitle_zh: 这些游客准备乘坐上午的 White Pass 景观火车；我们的行程安排在下午。
subtitle_en: These visitors take the morning White Pass train; our ride is in the afternoon.

subtitle_zh: 穿过游客集合区，我们先步行前往 Skagway 市中心。
subtitle_en: After the gathering area, we walk toward downtown Skagway.

subtitle_zh: 这就是开往 White Pass 的观光列车，下午我们也会乘坐它翻越群山。
subtitle_en: This is the train to White Pass; we will ride it through the mountains.

subtitle_zh: 从港口走不了多远，就进入了 Skagway 历史街区。
subtitle_en: A short walk from the port brings us into Skagway's historic district.

subtitle_zh: 这里是历史悠久的 White Pass & Yukon Route 火车站。
subtitle_en: This is the historic White Pass & Yukon Route station.

subtitle_zh: 铁轨上还陈列着这节老火车，多年来每次来到这里都能看到它。
subtitle_en: This old train is displayed on the tracks; we see it whenever we come here.

subtitle_zh: 这是 Skagway 百年纪念雕像，
subtitle_en: This is the Skagway centennial statue,

subtitle_zh: 纪念当年参加克朗代克淘金热的淘金者和帮助他们翻越山岭的当地背夫。
subtitle_en: honoring Gold Rush prospectors and the local packers who helped them.

subtitle_zh: 这台巨大的机器是 White Pass 铁路使用过的旋转式除雪车，
subtitle_en: This huge machine is a rotary snowplow once used by the White Pass railway.
notes: rotary snowplow segment 1/2; source table time 4:52:16; shifted to avoid overlap.

subtitle_zh: 前方的巨大叶轮专门用来清除山间铁路上的厚雪。
subtitle_en: Its large front wheel cleared deep snow from the mountain railway.
notes: rotary snowplow segment 2/2; source table time 4:52:16; shifted to avoid overlap.

subtitle_en: From here, we walk slowly along Skagway's famous Broadway Street.

subtitle_en: where we can now see the Alaska Geographic sign.

subtitle_en: the old Arctic Brotherhood lodge.

subtitle_zh: 最特别的是，它的外墙全部由漂流木拼接而成，因此也被认为是史凯威最具辨识度的历史建筑之一。
subtitle_en: Its driftwood exterior makes it one of Skagway's most recognizable buildings.

subtitle_zh: 这里是 The Pantheon。
subtitle_en: This is The Pantheon.

subtitle_zh: 这座建筑曾是淘金热时期最豪华的剧院之一，
subtitle_en: This building was one of the finest Gold Rush theaters,

subtitle_zh: 也是当年歌舞表演的重要场所。
subtitle_en: and an important venue for music and dance performances.

subtitle_zh: 如今，它已经成为克朗代克淘金热国家历史公园的一部分，
subtitle_en: Today it is part of the Klondike Gold Rush park,

subtitle_zh: 继续向游客讲述那段充满传奇色彩的淘金历史。
subtitle_en: continuing to tell visitors that legendary Gold Rush history.

subtitle_en: Several performers in 19th-century costumes

subtitle_zh: 从楼上的窗户向游客挥手、打招呼。
subtitle_en: wave and greet visitors from upstairs windows.

subtitle_zh: 她们扮演着淘金热时期酒馆和娱乐场所里的女性角色。
subtitle_en: They play women from Gold Rush saloons and entertainment halls.

subtitle_zh: 轻松幽默的互动，让眼前这些一百多年前的老建筑一下子有了生命，
subtitle_en: Their playful interaction suddenly brings these century-old buildings to life,

subtitle_zh: 也让我们仿佛短暂地回到了那个热闹的淘金年代。
subtitle_en: and briefly takes us back to that lively Gold Rush era.

subtitle_en: This is a Skagway Outlet,

subtitle_en: built during the Gold Rush.

subtitle_zh: 它最初计划作为一所学校使用，也是史凯威唯一的石砌建筑。

subtitle_en: The Kirmse family, in early Skagway,
